reviews.title: Great choice for RGB builds
reviews.comment: Truth be told, memory speed within a given tier is largely irrelevant when it comes to normal real world performance. With that being said, these perform excellent in addition to having a great visual design. I got these because I couldn't find any other memory with a full white heat spreader and full length RGB. These fit the bill perfectly and I have had no issues. The XMP works just fine, but I chose to use default timings as XMP is overkill the rest of the components of the build. I cannot comment on longevity of these as they have only been in use for a month, but I will update my review if I run into what I think are signs of bad QC.
reviews.author: B.B.

reviews.title: Just make sure its on QVL for your motherboard...
reviews.comment: Looks nice.  Fast memory.  Was causing issues on the asrock taichi z790 until a bios update.  I had to run at JEDEC 5600hz for RaptorLake for awhile or else running any games or benchmarks would just crash. Once asrock updated their bios, it runs stable at XMP profile. For some reasons, the RGB lighting couldn't be controlled by Asrock rgb program so I am stuck with the rainbow effect for now. Do you really need fast memory?  Probably not, save the extra $100-150 for a better or bigger m.2 NVME is my suggestion.

reviews.title: Great Speed
reviews.comment: This is my 1st PC build in 12yrs. Love the look & RGB on these. Seems to be a good set, with good heatsink & great speed.
reviews.author: Joshua

reviews.title: Awesome RAM
reviews.comment: This ram was a really great bang for its buck. When I got it I was kind of scared on how to install it in fear of breaking something because my Pc is really expensive but it went in perfectly, started up right away, and booted with no problem. BIG TIP MAKE SURE YOUR MOTHERBOARD SUPPORTS THE MHZ THESE STICKS PROVIDE. If it doesn’t then you will be stuck using them at a lower speed than they’re capable of.
reviews.author: Kahaiola Tilini

reviews.title: Hit the 7200mhz mark
reviews.comment: Wow can’t believe how affordable DDR5 is now lol. I add this to a MSI Mag z790 tomahawk and enabled XMP and it booted. After that I updated the MSI bios and notice a new “memory tune setting” I put it on performance and it gave me about -10ns in latency and about 6% in pure read performance. I tested using TM5 memory test it was stable even after 2hrs. Only needs 1.4v very nice. RGB looks great.
